name: LoginCraft – Customize and Secure WordPress Login Page
author: Dotstore

sections.description:
Are you looking to secure and customize your WordPress login page?

LoginCraft is the ultimate WordPress login customization plugin that allows you to modify your login URL, customize the design, and add extra security layers to protect your website from unauthorized access and spam attacks.

With LoginCraft, you can personalize your login experience, enhance security with login attempt limits and Google reCAPTCHA, and even enable maintenance mode when needed—all with an easy-to-use interface.

Say goodbye to default WordPress login limitations and take full control of your site’s login page with LoginCraft.

📒 KEY FEATURES

  • Custom Login URL — Replace the default `/wp-admin` login URL with a custom one like `/my-login` to prevent unauthorized access attempts. When users enter the wrong login URL, redirect them to a 404 page, homepage, or any custom page.
  • Custom Logo & Branding — Replace the default WordPress logo with your own, adjust its size, and set a custom link to match your brand identity.
  • Custom Background — Modify the login page background with a solid colour or upload a custom background image for a more branded experience.
  • Login Attempt Limit — To prevent brute–force attacks, Restrict the number of login attempts. Users exceeding the limit will be locked out for a defined time period.
  • Google reCAPTCHA Integration — Protect your login page from bots and spam attacks by adding Google reCAPTCHA (it supports both v2 and v3).
  • Site-Wide Password Protection — Enable password protection to Secure your entire site, allowing only users with a valid password to access the front end.
  • Maintenance Mode — Easily put your website into maintenance mode and display a custom message, heading, description, and background image while it is temporarily unavailable.

🚀 PLUGIN USE CASES

  1. Prevent Unauthorized Login Attempts: To block hackers and brute-force attacks, hide the default WordPress login URL, and limit login attempts.
  2. Customize the Login Page to Match Your Brand: Modify the WordPress login page with your brand’s logo, background, and custom design.
  3. Add an Extra Layer of Security: Implement Google reCAPTCHA and restrict login attempts to keep your website safe from bots and spam attacks.
  4. Password-Protect Your Entire Site: Restrict frontend access to only authorized users with a valid password.
  5. Enable Maintenance Mode with a Custom Message: Display a professional maintenance page with your heading, description, and background image when your site is undergoing updates.

sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload logincraft to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
1. What does the LoginCraft plugin do?

LoginCraft allows you to customize your WordPress login page, change the default /wp-admin URL, add security features like Google reCAPTCHA and login attempt limits, and enable maintenance mode for your website.

2. How do I change my WordPress login URL with LoginCraft?

After installing LoginCraft, go to the plugin settings and enter your preferred custom login URL. Your custom URL will replace the default WordPress login URL (/wp-admin or /wp-login.php).

3. What happens if someone tries to access the old login URL?

If a user tries to access the old login URL, you can show a custom message or redirect them to a 404 page, homepage, or any custom page.

4. Can I add my own logo to the login page?

Yes! LoginCraft allows you to replace the default WordPress logo with your own. You can also customize its size and link URL.

5. How does the login attempt restriction feature work?

You can define the maximum number of login attempts a user can make before being temporarily locked out. This helps prevent brute force attacks on your login page.

6. Can I enable Google reCAPTCHA for additional security?

Yes, LoginCraft supports both Google reCAPTCHA v2 and v3 to protect your login page from bots and spam attacks.

7. Will this plugin work with other plugins?

Yes, LoginCraft is designed to work alongside most plugins without any conflicts. However, if you experience any issues, you can reach out for support. We will be happy to help!

8. How can I get support if I face any issues?

You can get support by posting your queries in the WordPress.org support forum or checking the plugin documentation.
